content:
morgan-sales: Halcyon Health POC Wed. They want Redwood Private deployed in their AWS account. Key asks: single static egress IP, avoid SNAT so IDS sees original client IPs, and guidance: TGW hub vs PrivateLink vs direct peering. Need a one-paragraph preflight for procurement.

zara-solutions: Confirming: customer-hosted runtime in their VPC, and control plane callbacks must be outbound-only. Is preserving client IPs a hard requirement or 'nice-to-have'?

morgan-sales: Hard requirement for IDS alerts during POC.

lee-netops: TL;DR:
- NAT Gateway -> provides static EIP but will SNAT; original IPs lost.
- To preserve client IPs: route traffic through their on-prem IDS via TGW/VPN/DirectConnect so packets are routed without SNAT, or deploy an L4 proxy that forwards X-Forwarded-For.
- PrivateLink: good when you only need specific service ports and want to avoid broad route exposure; costs per ENI per AZ.
- VPC Peering: simple but non-transitive; ok for small setups.

hana-security: For the questionnaire: require VPC Flow Logs, ALB access logs, and >=90d retention for POC. Recommend mTLS for control plane if they want stronger authentication; otherwise TLS 1.2+ outbound to our FQDNs.

morgan-sales: Also need a short firewall snippet to paste to their netops.

zara-solutions: Snippet:
```
# Outbound from Redwood nodes (customer-hosted):
- tcp 443 -> controlplane.redwood-inference.<region>.aws (FQDN)
- tcp 443 -> registry.redwood-inference.<region>.aws or use ECR VPC endpoints
- tcp 53 -> internal DNS resolver
# If using PrivateLink: create interface endpoints in 2 AZs; allow ENI SGs per docs.
```

ops-bot: internal doc: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/private-deploy/networking/preflight

morgan-sales: Can Zara/Lee/Hana join customer call Tue 11am PT to run checklist? Customer wants signoff same day.

zara-solutions: I'll be there.

lee-netops: In.

hana-security: First 30 mins only, but yes.
